svg.title: Kepler Dev — Folded planes monogram (light/footer variant)
svg.desc: Light cream variant of the footer wordmark, sized for the very dark forest footer surface. Same Fold geometry as the header variant at 24 px: pearl primary plane, warm stone secondary plane, pearl-300 aperture, bronze hairline along the top of the right plane. Text: KEPLER DEV in tracked uppercase system sans, pearl.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
